versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious activity in shell commands
versions.detection:
keywords:
    # Apache Struts in-the-wild exploit codes  
    - 'stop;service iptables stop;'
    - 'stop;SuSEfirewall2 stop;'
    - 'wget * - http* | perl'
    - 'wget * - http* | sh'
    - 'wget * - http* | bash'
    # Metasploit framework exploit codes
    - 'base64 -d /tmp/'
condition: keywords
versions.spl: "stop;service iptables stop;" OR "stop;SuSEfirewall2 stop;" OR "wget * - http* | perl" OR "wget * - http* | sh" OR "wget * - http* | bash" OR "base64 -d /tmp/"
